nom: ANUA 8 Hyaluronic Acid Hydrating Gentle Foaming Cleanser

segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: several report no irritation and relief for perioral dermatitis or rosacea, while one describes new dermatitis with redness and peeling around the eyes after use.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin describe the cleanser as hydrating, leaving skin less dry, plump and soft rather than stripped.
segments.mature: One reviewer using tretinoin (mature/actives-adjacent routine) found it non-irritating and softening despite an initial medicinal smell.

concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers say the cleanser leaves skin hydrated, soft, plump and less dry, including one who compares it favorably to La Roche Posay Toleriane for dryness and stinging.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with rosacea and perioral/perifacial dermatitis report the cleanser does not trigger redness or irritation; one reviewer instead developed new red, peeling skin and hives around the eyes.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers describing reactive or compromised skin (dermatitis, rosacea) mostly report the cleanser is tolerated without stinging or flare-ups, but one reports an allergic-type reaction with facial hives and swelling after weeks of use.
concerns.spots: Opinions are strongly divided: multiple reviewers with acne-prone skin report no new breakouts and clearer skin, while three separate reviewers report the cleanser caused or worsened acne, including cystic and painful pimples on the forehead and cheeks.
concerns.blemishes: Same divide as spots: some acne-prone and sensitive-skin users report full clearing with no irritation, while others report large, painful pimples appearing during continuous use and clearing only after stopping.

aspects.libelle: Soft, supple skin feel after rinsing
Good value / goes a long way
Triggers new breakouts for some users

extraits.titre: This gave me dermatitis around my eyes
extraits.texte: I've never had a reaction to a face wash but this one gave me red peeling skin. Beware if you have sensitive skin.

extraits.titre: gave me horrible acne.. worst cleanser ever
extraits.texte: i've had this cleanser for about 2 months now, and at first when i starting using it, my skin started growing acne on my forehead and cheeks. i thought it was just hormonal acne or that i was just purging from using a new product. i kept using it and my skin would just get WORSE. a new pimple would grow on my face every day, and it would be so painful. i've never had such horrible acne until i used this product. i continuously used it for a month and the only results i got was red, large acne and pimples. i stopped using it and switched to a different cleanser, and my skin healed and cleared all its redness and bumps thanks to switching to something different. but i recently ran out of the cleanser and had to switch back to this for the moment. and not such a surprise, but my acne is back again and i currently have this huge pimple on my forehead that is literally so painful to touch. going to ulta to restock on the cleanser that healed my skin asap. (its the snail rescue purifying cleanser by peach slices. i love it so much!!)

I used this product for a good month and a half and was loving it. I had clear skin when all of a sudden on the 6th week of use my face broke out SOO BAD, red hives all over my face, irritation and swelling. I honestly thought it was an allergic reaction to something i had eaten, until the next morning i washed my face and the same thing happened. Ive discontinued using this cleanser and my face is much happier. Took about a week to fully heal.

I've been on the hunt for cleansers that are safe for my increasingly sensitive skin, and this has been great, so far. It hasn't bothered my perifacial dermatitis, at all. It also does the job of actually getting my skin clean. I also love how hydrating it is while being oil free. My only caveat is that it does sting a bit if some suds get in my eyes; which has not been an issue with the last couple cleansers that I've used.

Omg!!! I have the most sensitive and acne prone skin. Its also dry and I suffer from perioral dermatitis. Vanicream is my go to cleanser, but Ive been wanting something more hydrating. This has been the BEST cleanser I have ever used. I've been using it for a month now and theres no irritation or acne. This truly cleans my face AND leaves it so soft. Highly reccomend!

My skin reacts to truly everything — fragrance, essential oil, pretty much any type of oil, shea butter, all things coconut, etc. I'd been using La Roche Posay Toleriane for a long time, but occasionally it would sting my skin. Tried this cleanser per SkinSort's recommendation, and wow I'm glad I did. No stinging. My skin is less dry and more plump. Zero irritation. Great price point. A little goes a long way with the product. LOVE! Give it a try!
Have rosacea and this makes my skin feel soft and doesnt irritate it.
